instruction: A Dutch-style canal quarter at dusk: an arched stone bridge over dark green water, rows of tall narrow gabled houses with lit windows, a moored wooden boat with flower planters, bicycles leaning on railings, cast-iron lamps reflecting in the canal, a laundry line between buildings, and ducks gliding under the bridge arch.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Canal Bridge Quarter. A Dutch-style canal quarter at dusk: an arched stone bridge over dark green water, rows of tall narrow gabled houses with lit windows, a moored wooden boat with flower planters, bicycles leaning on railings, cast-iron lamps reflecting in the canal, a laundry line between buildings, and ducks gliding under the bridge arch. Style: dutch storybook. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
